sources.snippet: What is Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8? Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct-FP8 is an optimized version of Meta's LLaMA 3.1 model, specifically designed for efficient deployment while maintaining nearly identical performance to its full-precision counterpart.
